ITEM 1 | Mound of cooked white grains, off-white to pale cream with slight translucency, separate loose grains with some clumping, matte surface with no visible sheen or oil, moist-looking but not juiciness-soaked, holds a rounded heap about 9 cm across and roughly 2 cm tall at center, sitting on a white square plate with scattered stray grains around the edges, no browning or char | 180

ITEM 2 | Scattered individual loose grains, pale white and slightly glossy, spread thinly around the outer rim of the heap on the white square plate, each piece about 0.5 cm long, no clumping, no sauce or coating | 15
